    StartersWarm olives, almonds and parmesan crispsOlives with orange and fennel, rosemary almonds, baked parmesan roundsHow to make it250g olives2 tbsp olive oil1 strip of orange peel1 tsp fennel seeds150g almonds1 sprig of rosemary1 tsp salt100g parmesan, gratedWarm the olives in the oil with orange peel and fennel seeds.Roast the almonds at 170°C with rosemary and salt.Bake small rounds of parmesan at 190°C.Serve in little bowls.Hollywood pool party smash slidersThe Hollywood party by the poolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin beef patties smashed on a smoking griddle with caramelised onion, cheddar, pickles and a spicy burger sauce on toasted brioche slider buns.Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in butter for 20 minutes.Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp sriracha and 1 tbsp chopped pickles.Roll 600g beef mince into 12 balls.Smash thin on a smoking hot pan, salt, cook 90 seconds, flip, top with cheddar and onions and cook 1 minute.Toast 12 brioche slider buns, spread with sauce and add a patty and pickles.Charcuterie with cornichons and grissiniMia named it. Seb wanted Chicken on a Stick.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsParis bistro chickenTarragon butter roast chicken, silky mashed potatoes, Dijon-dressed leavesHow to make it60g butter, softened, for the chicken1 tbsp fresh tarragon, chopped1.8kg whole chicken1kg potatoes, peeled100g butter, for the mash1 bag of salad leaves2 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp Dijon mustard1 tbsp white wine vinegarMix the softened butter with the tarragon and push under the chicken skin.Roast at 220°C, then drop to 180°C.Rest and carve.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter for the mash until silky.Whisk the oil, mustard and vinegar and toss through the leaves.Chicken on a Stick, Korean BBQ skewersThe club name Seb drops for Seb'sHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs on skewers glazed in gochujang, soy and honey, charred LA street-cart style, with steamed rice, kimchi slaw and sesame.Mix 3 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp sesame oil and 2 grated garlic cloves.Toss 1kg diced chicken thighs in half the mix for 1 hour, then thread onto skewers.Grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and brushing with the rest.Toss shredded cabbage with 100g chopped kimchi and lime.Serve on rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.SweetsObservatory starry chocolate tartDark chocolate ganache tart with flaky salt and edible gold starsHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry250g dark chocolate250ml thickened cream1 pinch of flaky salt1 tbsp edible gold starsHeat the oven to 180°C. Line a tart tin with the sweet shortcrust pastry and blind bake.Melt the chocolate into the cream until smooth.Pour into the case and set.Finish with flaky salt and gold stars.Studio lot almond croissantsDay-old croissants filled with almond cream and baked with flaked almondsHow to make it60g butter, softened60g caster sugar60g almond meal1 egg4 day old croissants2 tbsp flaked almonds1 tbsp icing sugarHeat the oven to 180°C. Beat the butter, sugar, almond meal and egg into almond cream.Split the croissants and fill with the cream.Top with flaked almonds.Bake.Dust with icing sugar.DrinksJazz club old fashionedBourbon, sugar cube and bitters stirred over a big cube with orange peelHow to make it240ml bourbon4 sugar cubes8 dashes of aromatic bitters2 cups ice1 orange, peel onlyMuddle the sugar cubes with the bitters in a mixing glass.Add the bourbon and ice and stir.Strain over a big cube in each glass.Twist orange peel over the top.Gin rickey with limeCity of stars, one more for the road.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
